text: Lets you mix deterministic, hand-coded logic with LLM-driven agentic steps in the same graph
quote: LangGraph gives you fine-grained control to mix deterministic, hand-coded steps with LLM-driven agentic steps in the same graph

text: Checkpointers persist a thread's graph state, giving thread-scoped short-term memory, HITL support, time travel, and fault tolerance
quote: Checkpointers persist a thread's graph state as checkpoints. Use them for short-term, thread-scoped memory, including conversation continuity, human-in-the-loop workflows, time travel, and fault tolerance.

text: Stores persist application data outside graph state for long-term, cross-thread memory (preferences, facts, shared knowledge)
quote: Stores persist application-defined data outside the graph state. Use them for long-term, cross-thread memory, including user preferences, facts, and shared knowledge.

text: Interrupts let you pause graph execution at specific points and wait for external input
quote: Interrupts allow you to pause graph execution at specific points and wait for external input before continuing.

text: Execution resumes by re-invoking the graph with a Command object that becomes the interrupt() return value
quote: you resume execution by re-invoking the graph using Command, which then becomes the return value of the interrupt() call from inside the node

text: Exposes multiple stream modes (updates, values, messages, custom, checkpoints, tasks, debug) for graph execution
quote: It exposes graph execution through stream modes such as updates, values, messages, custom, checkpoints, tasks, and debug.

text: Provides separate iterators per stream projection (messages, values, subgraphs, output) that can be consumed independently
quote: Event streaming gives you separate iterators per projection (messages, values, subgraphs, output) so you can consume them independently

text: Models agent workflows as graphs defined via State, Nodes, and Edges components
quote: At its core, LangGraph models agent workflows as graphs. You define the behavior of your agents using three key components

text: Graph compilation performs structural checks (e.g., no orphaned nodes) and lets you set runtime args like checkpointers/breakpoints
quote: It provides a few basic checks on the structure of your graph (no orphaned nodes, etc). It is also where you can specify runtime args like checkpointers and breakpoints.

text: Short-term memory can be added to agent state to enable multi-turn conversation tracking
quote: Short-term memory (thread-level persistence) enables agents to track multi-turn conversations.

text: Supports building bespoke execution flows that mix deterministic logic with agentic behavior, embedding other patterns as nodes
quote: Build bespoke execution flows with LangGraph, mixing deterministic logic and agentic behavior. Embed other patterns as nodes in your workflow.

text: Production deployments can use a database-backed checkpointer (e.g., PostgresSaver) for durable state persistence
quote: In production, use a checkpointer backed by a database: from langgraph.checkpoint.postgres import PostgresSaver

text: Composing nodes and edges allows building complex, looping workflows that evolve state over time
quote: By composing Nodes and Edges, you can create complex, looping workflows that evolve the state over time.

text: Graphs expose stream/astream methods to yield streamed outputs as iterators
quote: LangGraph graphs expose the stream (sync) and astream (async) methods to yield streamed outputs as iterators.

text: Provides several patterns for building multi-agent systems suited to different use cases
quote: Here are the main patterns for building multi-agent systems, each suited to different use cases

text: MCPAdapter lets LangChain agents discover and call tools from MCP servers
quote: LangChain agents call tools defined on MCP servers through MCPAdapter, which discovers a server's tools and adapts them into LangChain tools.

text: LangGraph CLI is a command-line tool for building and running the Agent Server locally
quote: LangGraph CLI is a command-line tool for building and running the Agent Server locally.

text: Checkpointing writes exact graph state so runs can resume later, even from an error state
quote: Checkpointing keeps your place: the checkpointer writes the exact graph state so you can resume later, even when in an error state.

text: Agent Server exposes API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, plus managed DB services for checkpointing/storage
quote: LangGraph CLI is a command-line tool for building and running the Agent Server locally. The resulting server exposes all API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, etc., and includes supporting services such as a managed database for chec

text: Positioned as an agent runtime and low-level orchestration framework for reliably handling complex agent tasks
quote: Design agents that reliably handle complex tasks with LangGraph, an agent runtime and low-level orchestration framework.

text: Supports adding long-term memory to store user-specific or application-level data across sessions
quote: Add long-term memory to store user-specific or application-level data across sessions.

text: Distinguishes workflows (predetermined code paths) from agents (dynamic, self-directed tool usage)
quote: Workflows have predetermined code paths and are designed to operate in a certain order.

text: Multi-agent systems coordinate specialized components to tackle complex workflows
quote: Multi-agent systems coordinate specialized components to tackle complex workflows.

text: Enables durable agents that persist through failures and resume exactly where they left off
quote: Build agents that persist through failures and can run for extended periods, automatically resuming from exactly where they left off.

text: Supports human-in-the-loop by inspecting and modifying agent state at any point during execution
quote: Seamlessly incorporate human oversight by inspecting and modifying agent state at any point during execution.

text: Creates stateful agents with both short-term working memory and long-term persistent memory across sessions
quote: Create truly stateful agents with both short-term working memory for ongoing reasoning and long-term persistent memory across sessions.

text: Provides scalable infrastructure for deploying stateful, long-running agent systems in production
quote: Deploy sophisticated agent systems confidently with scalable infrastructure designed to handle the unique challenges of stateful, long-running workflows.

text: Offers visualization tools via LangSmith to trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide runtime metrics for debugging
quote: Debugging with LangSmith — Gain deep visibility into complex agent behavior with visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide detailed runtime metrics.

text: Described as a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents
quote: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents.

text: Workflow patterns can be traced and compared using LangSmith tracing to see how data flows through each step
quote: Trace and compare these workflow patterns with LangSmith... Follow the tracing quickstart to see how data flows through each step.
